finding.title: Finding healthcare
finding.q1: Do I need an account to search?
finding.a1: No. You can search facilities, services and doctors without an account.
finding.q2: How is the waiting time calculated?
finding.a2: From the people waiting now and how long recent visits took at that facility. It is an estimate, shown only when the facility publishes live data.

queue.title: Joining a queue
queue.q1: Can I join a queue from home?
queue.a1: Yes, at facilities that allow it, before the daily cut-off time. Go when the app tells you to leave.
queue.q2: What happens if I am late?
queue.a2: Your place can move back a few places. Tell reception when you arrive.

booking.title: Booking appointments
booking.q1: How do I book a time?
booking.a1: Open a facility, choose a service and a free time, then confirm. You need to sign in to book.
booking.a2: Yes, from your visits, until the facility’s cancellation deadline.

arrival.title: Arrival and check-in
arrival.q1: What do I do when I arrive?
arrival.a1: Go to reception with your ticket number or booking code. Reception confirms your arrival.
arrival.q2: I have no smartphone. Can I still be served?
arrival.a2: Yes. Reception registers you and gives you a printed ticket; the screen shows and calls your number.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.a1: Each facility page lists the insurers it accepts for each service.
insurance.a2: The cost depends on the illness, tests and medicines. Amounts appear on your bill after the visit.

accounts.title: Patient accounts
accounts.a1: Yes. Add family members in your profile and book for them.
accounts.q2: How do I change my password?
accounts.a2: Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page to get a reset link by email.

documents.title: Documents and records
documents.a1: In Documents after you sign in. Each one has a code and QR that pharmacies can verify.
documents.q2: Can someone check my document is real?
documents.a2: Yes, with the code on the document at “Verify a document”.

technical.title: Technical support
technical.q1: The site is slow on my phone.
technical.a1: Turn on data saver in settings; pages also work after a first visit with a weak connection.
technical.a2: Allow notifications for MediLink in your browser and turn alerts on in your settings.

about.title: About MediLink
about.body: MediLink puts Rwanda's health facilities in one place: where they are, what they offer, which insurance they take and how long the wait is now. Patients join a queue or book a time; facilities run their day from the same system.
